notes: Side-effecting skill: writes real CRM deals and Gmail reply drafts (drafts only, never sent). Since D2 (2026-10-05) it opens no Drive folder or kickoff doc: /project-init does that at qualified. Baseline (no-skill) runs are intentionally omitted because they would create duplicate/garbage production records. Tested via a real live run + an idempotency re-run. Live window is widened to ~30d in the prompt because the 7d window is currently empty.

evals.name: live-month-intake
evals.prompt: Can you process the AI 顧問服務 consult inbounds from the past month? Log anything new into the CRM and draft the first replies.
evals.expected_output: Finds the discovery-call inquiries from website@zynkr.ai in the last ~30 days. Creates a CRM deal named 'Jane（轉職計劃中）AI 顧問' (stage=new, owner=Peter, pipeline=銷售流程, service_tier=advisory) and one first-reply Gmail draft to Jane's address, never sent. Creates no Drive folder, no kickoff doc and no 專案資料夾 line: /project-init opens those at qualified. Skips the 'GA4 Test' row as a test. Ends with a summary table listing both (Jane=created, GA4 Test=skipped).
assertions: Found the consult inbounds via Gmail and identified both inquiries (Jane + GA4 Test)
Created a CRM deal named exactly 'Jane（轉職計劃中）AI 顧問'
Deal fields correct: stage=new, owner=Peter Tu, pipeline=銷售流程, service_tier=advisory, priority=medium, lead_source=content, close_date=today+30
Find-or-created the contact and company and linked them to the deal
Logged exactly one 'created' activity for the deal
Created one first-reply Gmail draft for Jane as a new email to the address on her Email: line (not a reply in the website@zynkr.ai thread), and sent nothing
Created no Drive folder and no kickoff doc
The deal notes carry the source line and the brief context, and no 專案資料夾： line
Skipped the GA4 Test row as a test (no deal and no draft for it)
Reported the summary table (交易 and 回覆草稿 columns, no folder column) listing both leads and their outcomes

evals.name: idempotency-rerun
evals.prompt: 處理一下本月的顧問諮詢，有新的就建立 deal 跟回信草稿。
evals.expected_output: Run immediately after eval 0. Jane now has a deal, so she is de-duped (skipped): no second deal and no second reply draft. GA4 Test is skipped as a test row. Nothing new is created, and no folder or doc either. Report says no new leads this period and lists why each was skipped. Critically: does NOT create a duplicate Jane deal or a second draft.
assertions: Found the 2 inquiries again on re-run
Skipped Jane because a deal already exists for her email (dedup by email)
Skipped GA4 Test as a test row
Created 0 new deals — no duplicate Jane deal (DB count stays 1)
Created 0 new reply drafts — Jane's draft from eval 0 is not duplicated
Created no Drive folder or doc
Reported that nothing new was created, with per-lead skip reasons
